review: The hymn is consecration: 1:1–6 is Matt 11:28 (בּוֹאוּ אֵלַי כָּל־הָעֲיֵפִים) with John 14:6, 2:1–8 is Ps 31:6 (בְּיָדְךָ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי) with Matt 4:19 and 1 Thess 5:23, 3:1–8 is Ps 18:3 with Num 23:19, and 4:1–8 is Ps 42:2 with Jer 31:31–34.

1:3–6 reproduce a quoted speech; the Hebrew keeps the colon of 1:2 and the first-person 'I am Jesus' at the end, because the print makes the invitation the voice of Christ and the stanza turns on that identification.
2:1 uses the exact phrase of Ps 31:6 (בְּיָדְךָ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי) rather than a general 'I entrust', since the line is the psalm Christ quoted from the cross and the hymn is answering it.
